speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Master Shakespeare? Cuthbert Burbage. From Holywell.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Master Burbage. I hear you. What is the matter?

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: My father was up half the night, walking round the playhouse with a lantern. The matter is wood. A timber house in the fields, and a city in this temper.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Two hired men are to sleep in the tiring-house from tonight, at sixpence each. The yard gates are to be chained after the play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two men, and a chain. That is plain enough. And the flag?

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: My father would fly it higher. I would have it down on days there is trouble, since a white swan is a thing to throw at.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it up. A house that hides looks guilty.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: That's my father's opinion. I didn't think to hear it from the poet.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Then it's three to one. God keep you.
